newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes lower, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes lower, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed lower on Thursday amid little buying interest by spinners and exporters, brokers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Small purchases by spinners and exporters failed to relieve ginners holding more than one million 375-lb bales of unsold cotton at ginneries, broker Nasim Usman said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,075/2,200 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,425/2,450 and MNH-93 at 2,440/2,460.

The KCA said exporters had shipped 38,124 375-lb bales of cotton by April 10 compared to 1.73 million by the same date last year. Exporters had registered contracts for the export of 49,834 bales by April 23 compared to 2.32 million in the year-ago period.
